sections.title: Fixed point properties and cohomology of Banach representations of arithmetic groups
sections.abstract: The paper proves low-degree vanishing for group cohomology with L^p coefficients for higher-rank lattices and derives fixed-point and finite-orbit consequences.
sections.claimed_result: The authors claim vanishing below the rank and consequences proving conjectures by Farb and Gromov.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Higher-rank lattices and L^p representations without invariant vectors.
sections.caveat: Detailed hypotheses and proof dependencies require full-paper review.

sections.title: Boundedness of geometrically integral ε-klt del Pezzo surfaces
sections.abstract: The authors claim the remaining positive-characteristic boundedness cases for geometrically integral ε-klt del Pezzo surfaces.
sections.claimed_result: A uniform irregularity bound completes the theorem in all positive characteristics.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Geometrically integral ε-klt del Pezzo surfaces over arbitrary fields.
sections.caveat: The precise bound and mechanism are not in the abstract.

sections.title: $K^{\mathrm{ab}}$ has the Bogomolov property for canonical heights
sections.abstract: The paper claims a strong Bogomolov property over the maximal abelian extension and classifies exceptional backward-orbit pairs.
sections.claimed_result: It claims to settle the Andrews–Petsche conjecture in the stated rational-map setting.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Number fields and rational maps excluding power, signed Chebyshev, and Lattès maps.
sections.caveat: Definitions and exceptional-family details require the full paper.

sections.title: White's cone over the Möbius band is area-minimising
sections.abstract: A cone over a minimal Möbius band is claimed to be locally mass-minimising over Z_2.
sections.claimed_result: The paper claims to prove a conjecture of Brian White and classify a related family of minimizing hypercones.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Minimal surfaces and cones with mod-2 coefficients under a cylindrical-slice condition.
sections.caveat: The full definitions of the chosen Möbius band and hypotheses are needed.

sections.title: Extremal subtrees of critical beta-splitting trees
sections.abstract: The paper determines extremal subtree shapes in critical beta-splitting trees using Huffman coding.
sections.claimed_result: It answers cited questions of Aldous and Janson about clade distributions.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Critical beta-splitting trees and subtree-shape probabilities.
sections.caveat: Exact shapes and formulas are not stated in the abstract.

sections.title: A Contour Method for Multiparameter Eigenvalue Problems
sections.abstract: A multivariate residue formula yields a contour method for analytic multiparameter eigenvalue problems.
sections.claimed_result: The method computes all eigenvalues in a prescribed region and is embarrassingly parallelizable.
sections.caveat: Conditioning and general complexity guarantees remain to be assessed.

sections.title: Heat flow and repeated differentiation of polynomials with i.i.d. roots
sections.abstract: The paper identifies limiting root distributions under short-time heat flow and repeated differentiation.
sections.claimed_result: Almost-sure limits are claimed under regularity, small-time, and rotational-symmetry assumptions.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: i.i.d. complex roots with bounded compact support and stated Stieltjes-transform conditions.
sections.caveat: The results do not cover arbitrary laws or all times.

sections.title: Trefoil Probabilities and Polyhedra
sections.abstract: The exact probability of a trefoil in a random six-vertex spherical hexagon is computed.
sections.claimed_result: The trefoil probability is claimed to be 1/(16π²), with an exact regular-octahedral event probability.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Six independent uniform points on the unit sphere joined cyclically.
sections.caveat: The result is specific to the six-point spherical construction.
